summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several data processing points. First, the exclusion criteria for vendors were confirmed: for AFA or Citymedia on dates after September 17, 2020, vendors 0 and 2 must be excluded, along with anomalies.

Later, a request was made to add a `category` field to the `allunite.device_session_agg_ml` table for easier data management and re-loading by category.

Regarding predictive modeling (prediction), it was noted that historical data cannot be automatically pulled into the prediction model; manual steps are required. The team discussed integrating real-time prediction capabilities, aiming to complete the technical phase by next week due to an upcoming leave period before a release deadline.

Finally, regarding the factor used for rail predictions, the decision was made to keep the current factor until it is officially approved (expected Monday), even if it requires rebuilding the aggregated data later.
decisions: The `allunite.device_session_agg_ml` table will be updated with a `category` field.
The team aims to complete the technical phase for real-time prediction by next week.
The factor used for rail predictions will remain unchanged until official approval (expected Monday).
action_items: Someone needs to rebuild the aggregated data if the rail prediction factor changes after Monday.
